hints.title: Exact Rational Fraction Normalization
hints.text: Every rational number with finite and repeating decimal parts converts uniquely into an irreducible fraction numerator / denominator.

hints.title: Repeating Decimal Geometric Series Summation
hints.text: Decompose string into integer part I, non-repeating fractional part N, and repeating part R. R with length L repeating infinitely equals int(R) / (10^len(N) * (10^L - 1)).

hints.title: Fraction Conversion Blueprint
hints.text: Parse I, N, R using regex or string splitting. Form Fractions: int_part + non_rep_part + rep_part. Compare fraction(s) == fraction(t).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Fraction conversion and GCD reduction execute in constant time operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Floating point conversion suffers from precision loss on repeating decimals like 0.(9) == 1.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Exact integer rational arithmetic avoids all binary floating-point roundoff errors.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct formula for infinite geometric series repeating decimals: R / (10^N * (10^L - 1)).

solutions.approach: C++ Custom Fraction Struct with GCD Reduction
